summary: Mesa County Sheriff's deputies called ~12:30 p.m. to Persigo Wash to recover a body from the Colorado River; coroner estimated 2-6 months in the water; positively identified 2014-08-29 as Rodney Lee Crumbaker, 57, of Clifton via joint MCSO/Grand Junction PD/CBI effort; coroner's office to determine cause and manner of death
location: Persigo Wash, Colorado River near Grand Junction
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office (Mesa County Coroner's Office)
notes: Date from article text (Wednesday Aug. 20, 2014 — verified); unattended-death recovery; body-discovery row per index precedent (id 3135)
